_comment: Canonical Persona document shape. client is the authority - it creates and stores persona manifests for role-based access control. Personas map JWT roles to binding personas used in GovernanceEnvelope. A field mismatch breaks RBAC enforcement and governed action authorization.

persona._description: Declarative persona manifest for role-based access control. Personas map JWT roles to binding personas used in GovernanceEnvelope authorization.

id.description: Unique persona identifier. Stable string handle (e.g. 'sage', 'triage', 'auditor').

description.description: Description of the persona's role and responsibilities.

roles.description: JWT roles mapped to this persona. See status.json user.role.
